title: EEG-Based Schizophrenia Detection Using Deep Learning
description: A hybrid CNN–LSTM with attention that detects schizophrenia from multichannel EEG, reaching 97% accuracy on an 84-subject clinical dataset under a subject-wise split — 6–9% above CNN-only and LSTM-only baselines. Grad-CAM and Integrated Gradients surface which channels and time-segments drive each prediction. Paper accepted at ICSDP 2025.
stack: TensorFlow/Keras · scikit-learn · XGBoost · Grad-CAM · Integrated Gradients
